name: Machine-friendly naming conventions (snake_case ASCII)
normalization_algorithm: trim whitespace and remove UTF-8 BOM
convert CamelCase to snake_case by inserting '_' before capitals preceded by [a-z0-9]

resolution_strategies: keep one as legacy and alias

migration_strategy.step_0: Generate/update the column map across the bundle.
migration_strategy.step_1: Pick a single table (or small set) and apply renames.
migration_strategy.step_2: Update any validators/readers to use normalized names (or consult the map).
migration_strategy.step_3: Repeat until legacy is fully migrated.
migration_strategy.note: Do NOT attempt a mass rename across all tables in a single AJ.
